name: firstmate-mcp-ts
description: TypeScript sibling of the First Mate MCP smarts-only server (stdio parity, Effect composition)

scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node --test testbuild/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun test --timeout 180000 testbuild/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/test-runner.mjs
scripts.test:dev:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/test-runner.mjs --bun
scripts.test:failed: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/test-runner.mjs --failed-only
scripts.test:failed:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/test-runner.mjs --bun --failed-only
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node --test testbuild/tests/validators.test.js testbuild/tests/envelope.test.js testbuild/tests/auth.test.js testbuild/tests/followon.test.js testbuild/tests/server.test.js
scripts.test:fast:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun test --timeout 120000 testbuild/tests/validators.test.js testbuild/tests/envelope.test.js testbuild/tests/auth.test.js testbuild/tests/followon.test.js testbuild/tests/server.test.js
scripts.test:slow: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node --test testbuild/tests/timeout.test.js testbuild/tests/receipt.test.js
scripts.test:slow:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun test --timeout 180000 testbuild/tests/timeout.test.js testbuild/tests/receipt.test.js
scripts.conformance: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=node --shard=all
scripts.conformance:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=bun --shard=all
scripts.conformance:read: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=node --shard=read
scripts.conformance:read:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=bun --shard=read
scripts.conformance:remote: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=node --shard=remote
scripts.conformance:remote:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=bun --shard=remote
scripts.conformance:system: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=node --shard=system
scripts.conformance:system:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun scripts/conformance-runner.mjs --runtime=bun --shard=system
scripts.prove: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && node --test testbuild/tests/*.test.js
scripts.prove:bun: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:tests && bun test --timeout 180000 testbuild/tests/*.test.js
